title: Report Long/Short Covariance in Shot Pattern Dispersion
body:
## Problem

Lateral spread alone omitted carry covariance and long-left/short-right orientation.

## Acceptance Criteria

Report descriptive covariance, correlations, percentiles, quadrants and nominal offsets; avoid calibrated 2D confidence claims.

## Validation

tests/tools/shot_pattern_analysis/test_dispersion_stats.py

## Handoff

Branch: `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`. Current implementation and evidence are tracked in `docs/research/shot_pattern_analysis/issues/README.md`. Keep open until a merged implementing PR satisfies acceptance criteria or an explicitly permitted disposition applies.
